propositions: A contributor must be able to manually re-trigger an LLM-Review by commenting 'recheck-review' on a Gerrit change, enabling retry of non-finding infrastructure vetoes without pushing a new patchset.

The retrigger mechanism must refuse to re-review a change revision carrying a real finding-BLOCK tag (both bare and merge-change forms), with refusal message and no enqueue, to prevent stochastic re-rolling of genuine findings.

The retrigger mechanism must accept and re-queue all other LLM-Review -1 states (coverage-gap sub-reasons including gate-disabled and 0347 escalations, PASS, vote-less, or unparseable tags), resetting the shared 0347 retry budget and bypassing dedup/existing-vote short-circuits.

The bot must not trigger on its own comments, and non-matching comments must be silent no-ops; eligibility must be decided server-side from durable Gerrit change messages, not from contributor-supplied comment text.
The retrigger reply path must post messages with no 'labels' key in the Gerrit REST body, preserving vote independence and never writing a label value.
Webhooks.config must be updated to subscribe to comment-added events, and infra/gerrit/service-user.sh must be re-run by an operator to activate the trigger; until then the code path is inert.
